name: Downtown Parking Footprint - final parking-lot segmentation model
architecture: U-Net, MobileNet v1 0.25 encoder, 224x224 RGB NAIP tiles at zoom 17 (~0.6 m/px), 861,633 parameters
weights: round 8 (trained on OSM lots + human review rounds 1-7)
selection: A final retraining with the strict round-8 answers (6 epochs) did not beat these weights on the 45 held-out round-8 answers, so the round-8 weights were kept.
postProcessing: docs/review/pipeline.js with AI.FINAL = true: seeds p>=0.6 grown to p>=0.35; NAIP NIR NDVI>0.12 removed; cut back at OSM streets (class widths) and building footprints; drop if >30% buildings, >50% industrial/rail, >40% parks/landcover, area <1500 m2 or mean p <0.7; outline = oriented rectangle or right-angle (rectilinear) polygon in the lot orientation, no diagonal cuts.
use: Candidates are proposals; only human-confirmed lots are used in published figures.
